theme: An open Saturday, with the board to tidy before Sunday.
greeting: The calendar's clear today, Dan — the FloridaRAMA outing with the girls is the one fixed point. The bigger thread is the Croatia countdown: a handful of bookings still have to close before you sail Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: Board cleanup with Mike at 9 AM
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's 15-minute Sunday review is on the calendar for 9 AM — every open item gets an owner and a date, and anything stalled three weeks running gets cut. A quick tidy tonight makes it painless.

needsAttention.title: Nautilus sailing balance still open
needsAttention.detail: QuickBooks shows invoice 2170 for the Croatia charter unpaid at $6,475, and the latest reminder says the payment isn't finished. Worth closing well before you fly on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Last lodging gaps before you sail
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 Cavtat night after the charter and the Sept 20–22 St Pete landing gap are both still unbooked — and the boat has no signal, so they have to be handled from dry land before departure.
